observations: Photo 0 shows a large, black and silver printer wrapped in clear plastic.
The printer has a label on the front with images of the printer and text, but the text is not legible.
The label includes a barcode and some small images, possibly of the printer in use or in different settings.
The printer appears to be a large-format or enterprise model, given its size and design.
The plastic wrap is intact, suggesting the item is new or well-preserved.
The background is a concrete or paved surface, possibly outdoors or in a warehouse.

risks.risk: The printer may be damaged or non-functional despite the plastic wrap.

risks.risk: The printer may be a refurbished or used unit, not new as implied by the plastic wrap.

risks.if_unproven: priced as used, with lower value

risks.risk: The printer may not be the exact model claimed (e.g., not CP4525 or not color laserjet).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the printer, preferably on the front or side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, which may be lower than CP4525

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the original packaging.
A clear photo of the model label on the printer, preferably on the front or side.
A video or photo showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.
A photo of the serial number and any signs of wear or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
